title: Google Video
statusNote: Active. Page updated 2026-09-24 (later than most pages).
notes: Not checked: SeekToAction needs potentialAction with startOffset-input and target to get automatic key moments; "startOffset-input" is not a schema.org property.
Not checked: hasPart rules are for Clip values.
Not checked: provide contentUrl or embedUrl; use ineligibleRegion or regionsAllowed, not both.

Provide contentUrl if possible, else embedUrl (page recommends both; at least one). creator may be replaced by author (creator.name needs name or alternateName). thumbnailUrl is repeated URL. uploadDate ISO 8601, timezone recommended.
Regions: use ineligibleRegion OR regionsAllowed (ISO 3166-1, 2 or 3 letters). interactionStatistic types: WatchAction, LikeAction, CommentAction, ShareAction (interactionCount still supported).
BroadcastEvent (LIVE badge) fields required only to get the badge: publication (BroadcastEvent) with isLiveBroadcast, startDate, endDate (endDate required once stream has ended).
Clip (key moments): name, startOffset, url required; endOffset recommended.
SeekToAction: potentialAction with startOffset-input and target (EntryPoint with placeholder URL) required only to get automatic key moments.
